editorialIntro.heading: What Is the Oceania Club Loyalty Program?
paragraphs: Oceania Club is the loyalty program for guests who sail with Oceania Cruises. It rewards returning travelers with membership privileges, exclusive offers, shipboard credits, beverage-package savings and additional onboard benefits as they accumulate cruise credits.

The program has six membership levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and President's Circle. Your membership level is determined by the number of qualifying cruise credits you earn through completed Oceania voyages.

The higher your tier, the more privileges become available. Depending on your membership level, these can include priority terminal check-in, complimentary wine tastings, Aquamar Spa treatment credits, savings on the Prestige Select beverage package and other rewards.

Oceania Club also participates in Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings' Loyalty Status Honoring Program, which allows eligible members to receive equivalent loyalty recognition when sailing with Regent Seven Seas Cruises or Norwegian Cruise Line, subject to the program's terms.

The short answer: Oceania Club rewards repeat Oceania guests with benefits that increase as they earn cruise credits. Travelers who sail frequently or take longer voyages may progress through the tiers more quickly.

cruiseCreditAccrual.title: How Do You Earn Oceania Club Cruise Credits?
paragraphs: Oceania Club members earn cruise credits determined by the published duration of completed voyages. Unlike programs based solely on dollar spend, Oceania awards multiple credits on longer voyages, enabling guests who take extended sailings to advance rapidly.
A standard 10-day voyage earns 1 credit, while a 70-day Grand Voyage earns 7 credits, and a 180-day World Cruise earns 15 credits in a single journey.

included.description: Two complimentary custom air administrative fee waivers ($398 published combined value) for Gold members and above.

extras.title: Per-Stateroom Benefit Limits
extras.description: Shipboard and spa credits are allocated per stateroom based on double occupancy, not doubled for two elite guests sharing.

extras.title: Non-Refundable / No Cash Value

extras.title: Airline Differentials & Route Costs

extras.title: Personal Onboard Incidentals

crossBrandRecognition.title: Can You Use Oceania Club Status on Regent or Norwegian?

rhine.title: Status Honoring on Regent Seven Seas
rhine.subtitle: Seven Seas Society Tier Alignment
features: Tier Alignment: Oceania Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum map directly to Regent Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
Diamond & President's Circle: Both elite tiers map to Regent Titanium status, Regent's highest recognized honors tier.
Accrual Integrity: Cruise credits do not transfer between lines; voyages sailed on Regent accumulate Seven Seas Society credits.
Advance Request Required: Guests must submit reservation details and loyalty numbers at least 10 business days before sailing.
Milestone Exclusions: Milestone cruise credits, complimentary cruises, and tier upgrade vouchers do not cross over.

danube.title: Status Honoring on Norwegian Cruise Line
danube.subtitle: Latitudes Rewards Tier Alignment
features: Tier Alignment: Oceania Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum correspond to NCL Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum.
Diamond & President's Circle: Both elite Oceania tiers map to NCL Ambassador status, unlocking top-tier Latitudes perks.
Single-Voyage Scope: Recognition applies temporarily to the specific confirmed sailing and does not permanently change NCL status.
Processing Timeline: NCL requires at least 10 days' advance notice and may take up to 72 business hours to verify recognition.
Excluded Benefits: Onboard casino tier matching, free milestone cruise certificates, and specialty dining certificates are excluded.

bookingEligibilityChecklist.subtitle: PROGRAM CONDITIONS & PRE-BOOKING VERIFICATION

items.title: Double-Occupancy & Stateroom Rules
items.description: Most benefits, including shipboard and spa credits, are calculated per stateroom based on double occupancy. When two elite members share a cabin, benefits are not doubled.

items.title: Commercial vs. Restricted Fares
items.description: Standard public commercial fares qualify fully for cruise credit accrual. However, certain interline rates, employee fares, contest prizes, and charters are excluded.

items.title: Promotional Rate Compatibility
items.description: Select travel-advisor promotional group rates or limited-time flash sales may restrict the combination of full loyalty benefits or shipboard credits with promotional pricing.

items.title: Attaching Your Club ID Early
items.description: Your Oceania Club membership number must be attached to the reservation at the time of deposit to ensure priority check-in and loyalty amenities load properly.

items.title: Non-Transferable & No Cash Value
items.description: Loyalty privileges and cruise credits belong strictly to the individual member; they cannot be transferred, sold, or redeemed for cash if left unused.

items.title: Pre-Booking Verification Checklist
items.description: Always confirm that your reservation invoice explicitly lists active cruise-credit accrual, tier amenities, and whether milestone rewards apply.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Club
faqs.subtitle: Clear, Authoritative Answers Regarding Tiers, Credits & Rewards

questions.question: What is Oceania Club?
questions.answer: Oceania Club is the loyalty program for Oceania Cruises guests. Members earn cruise credits through qualifying voyages and progress through six membership levels, unlocking additional onboard benefits and privileges.

questions.question: What are the Oceania Club membership levels?
questions.answer: The six levels are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and President's Circle.

questions.question: How many cruise credits do you need for Oceania Club Bronze?
questions.answer: Bronze requires 2 cruise credits under Oceania's published tier structure.

questions.question: How many cruise credits are required for Silver?
How many cruise credits are required for Gold?
How many cruise credits are required for Platinum?
How many cruise credits are required for Diamond?
How many cruise credits are required for President's Circle?
questions.answer: President's Circle requires 60 or more accumulated cruise credits.

questions.question: How do you earn Oceania Club cruise credits?
questions.answer: Members earn credits based on the length of qualifying voyages. A voyage of up to 24 days earns one credit, while longer voyages earn additional credits according to Oceania's published schedule.

questions.question: Does a longer Oceania cruise earn more loyalty credits?
questions.answer: Yes. Longer qualifying voyages earn more cruise credits. For example, a voyage lasting 100–157 days earns 10 credits under the published schedule.

questions.question: Do Oceania Club members receive shipboard credit?
questions.answer: Yes. The published benefit schedule ranges from $100 for Bronze members to $1,250 for President's Circle members per stateroom. Terms and restrictions apply.

questions.question: Which Oceania Club members receive spa credits?
questions.answer: Gold, Platinum, Diamond and President's Circle members receive two complimentary Aquamar Spa treatment credits. The value of each credit varies by membership tier.

questions.question: Do Oceania Club members receive beverage-package discounts?
questions.answer: Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond members receive 10% savings on the Prestige Select beverage package under the published benefits. President's Circle members receive a complimentary package subject to program terms.

questions.question: Do Oceania Club members receive priority check-in?
questions.answer: Yes. Priority terminal check-in is a published benefit for Platinum, Diamond and President's Circle members.

questions.question: Does Oceania Club include complimentary laundry?
questions.answer: Complimentary laundry service is listed as a President's Circle benefit. The applicable program terms and conditions should be checked before sailing.
